Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 13: the slip of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“During battle with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons. While aboard a starfighter, it is power, maneuver, and hyperspeed +3. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile.”), word for word the text of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>bb70257deeb8f4e3a728b1dc233dca01e96e3f6b8124e95ed04ad3a8f75e98d3</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[404, 157, 588, 242]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B2).
